text_blocks.snippet: Standard Bank offers vehicle and asset finance (VAF) for both personal and business needs, providing financing for vehicles, construction equipment, and other assets. They offer flexible repayment terms, linked or fixed interest rates, and access to finance facilities. For businesses, Standard Bank finances various commercial vehicles like delivery vans and trucks.
Key Features of Standard Bank Vehicle Finance:

list.title: Personal Vehicle Finance:
list.snippet: Standard Bank provides financing for new and used vehicles, including cars, trucks, and SUVs, with options for flexible repayment terms and interest rate structures.

list.title: Business Vehicle Finance:
list.snippet: For businesses, they offer financing for a range of commercial vehicles like delivery vans, flat-bed trucks, and HCVs.

list.title: Flexible Repayment Terms:
list.snippet: Customers can structure their monthly repayments to align with their specific cash flow and budget.

list.title: Interest Rate Options:
list.snippet: Standard Bank offers both fixed and linked interest rate options, allowing customers to choose based on their preference and risk appetite.

list.title: Access Facility:
list.snippet: Customers can potentially reduce interest costs by linking their finance agreement to an Access Finance Account.

list.title: Finance Leasing Facility:
list.snippet: This facility allows Standard Bank to acquire the asset and lease it to the client for a set period.

list.title: Sale and Leaseback:
list.snippet: This option allows businesses to convert existing assets into working capital while still retaining the use of the asset.

list.title: Insurance Premium Financing:
list.snippet: Short-term loans are available to finance annual insurance premiums.

list.title: Online Application and Tools:
list.snippet: Standard Bank provides online tools, like a car loan calculator, to help customers estimate monthly payments and explore financing options.

list.title: EasySell Option:
list.snippet: Customers can sell their vehicles through Standard Bank's EasySell program, potentially helping with financial difficulties.
